extension.description: 🤖 AI-Powered VSCode extension for generating standardized Git/SVN commit messages. ✨ Supports 20+ AI services: OpenAI, Ollama, VS Code AI, Zhipu AI, DashScope, Doubao AI, Gemini, Deepseek, Anthropic, Mistral, Azure OpenAI, VertexAI, LMStudio and more. 🌍 19 languages supported. 📊 Features: AI commit generation, code review, weekly reports, branch naming, PR summaries, token statistics.

Suppress non-critical warning popups, such as context length warnings. Also available in Webview UI.

Specify the target for git diff. Also available in Webview UI.
- `staged`: Only analyze staged changes
- `all`: Analyze all working directory changes
- `auto`: Auto-detect staged changes, fallback to all
When `diffTarget` is `auto`, automatically detect staged content and prioritize it over all changes.
When staged area is empty, fallback to analyze all working directory changes.
Enable diff content simplification to reduce token usage. **Warning**: Enabling this may result in less accurate commit messages.
Prefix commit messages with emoji (e.g. `feat: ...`). Also available in Webview UI.
Allow merging changes from multiple files into a single commit message. Also available in Webview UI.
Include body content in commit messages. If disabled, only the subject line will be generated. Also available in Webview UI.
Generate layered commit messages with a global summary followed by per-file details. Also available in Webview UI.
Extract global context to enhance correlation between file descriptions. Only effective when `enableLayeredCommit` is `true`. Also available in Webview UI.
Custom system prompt for commit message generation. Leave empty to use the default prompt. Also available in Webview UI.

Behavior when the diff prompt exceeds the model's token limit. Also available in Webview UI.
- `ask`: Prompt the user to choose
- `useFallback`: Automatically use a simplified prompt
- `continue`: Send the full prompt anyway
Use recent commit history as reference context to improve message style consistency. Also available in Webview UI.
Custom system prompt for weekly report generation. Leave empty to use the default prompt.
Custom system prompt for code review. Leave empty to use the default prompt.
Custom system prompt for branch name generation. Leave empty to use the default prompt.

Action to perform after generating a branch name.
- `ask`: Let the user choose each time
- `createAndCopy`: Auto-create branch and copy name
- `copyOnly`: Only copy the name to clipboard

How to present branch name suggestions.
- `autoFirst`: Auto-select the first suggestion
- `quickPick`: Show a quick-pick list for user selection

Action when branch creation fails (e.g., name conflict).
- `ask`: Let the user choose
- `copyOnly`: Copy the name to clipboard
Base branch for comparing commits to generate PR summary. Default: `origin/main`
Head branch for comparing commits to generate PR summary. Default: `HEAD`
Custom system prompt for PR summary generation. Leave empty to use the default prompt.
Maximum number of commit logs to fetch when generating PR summaries. Higher values provide more context but use more tokens.
Enable third-party model catalog sync to automatically retrieve token limit information for known models. Also available in Webview UI.
Enable adaptive learning of input token limits based on model responses. Helps optimize token usage over time. Also available in Webview UI.
Enable the weekly report generation feature. Also available in Webview UI.
Enable the AI code review feature. Also available in Webview UI.
Enable the AI branch name generation feature. Also available in Webview UI.
Enable the AI PR summary generation feature. Also available in Webview UI.
